Class LevelManager

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.gameLogic.LevelManager
public class LevelManager extends Object
Manages game progression, difficulty scaling, and speed calculations.

This class tracks the total number of lines cleared and automatically increases the game level every 10 lines. As the level increases, the game speed (delay between ticks) decreases based on an exponential decay formula, making the pieces fall faster.

Author:
Jacob Villegas

  • Method Details

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets the level manager to its initial state.

      Sets total lines to 0, level to 1, and speed to the base configuration. This is called when starting a new game.

    • addLines

      public boolean addLines(int lines)
      Registers cleared lines and checks for a level-up.

      The logic follows a "10 lines per level" rule. If the total lines cleared crosses a multiple of 10, the level increases.

      Parameters:
      lines - The number of lines cleared in the most recent move (1-4).
      Returns:
      true if the speed has changed (level up occurred), indicating that the game loop needs to be updated; false otherwise.

    • recalculateSpeed

      private boolean recalculateSpeed(int level)
      recalculates the game speed based on the new level.

      Formula: Speed = Base_Speed * (Multiplier ^ (Level - 1))
      The result is clamped so it never goes below GameConfig.MAX_SPEED_CAP.

      Parameters:
      level - The new level to calculate speed for.
      Returns:
      true if the new speed is significantly different from the old speed.
